column1: # Every environment name the dashboard's server bundle reads, and the names in its process
# environment. Gate 60-env holds it against a walk of the bundle's syntax trees (envwalk.mjs).
#   NAME  set             in the server's process environment: the agent's fixed names
#                         (dashcfg.StudioEnv), the names of the image's label
#                         supapace.studio.env, Docker's HOSTNAME and HOME, the image's own ENV
#   NAME  unset           read by the bundle, never in its process environment (so the code
#   NAME  dynamic  FILE   FILE (a path under .output/server, a bundler hash written [hash])
#                         holds a read that cannot be resolved to a name; one row per name it
#                         can yield: a name, a family PREFIX_*, * when it hands the whole
#                         environment on, or - when it touches the process object and yields
# A patch that changes what the server reads changes these rows in the same commit.
